'''Resdox''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[Vice Admiral]] in the [[Resistance]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], he was present in the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

When the Resistance began [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuating]] the D'Qar base, Resdox was assigned to the [[Nebulon-C escort frigate|medical frigate]] [[Anodyne (Nebulon-C)|''Anodyne'']].<ref name="TLJ VD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Resdox was portrayed by [[James McGrath]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], and was first named in the film's credits. While he doesn't appear on-screen, it is noted in the ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' he is present with the Resistance Navy ships that participated in evacuating D'Qar after the events of ''The Force Awakens''.
